# Santon et al. 2025 -- treadmill data

`Treadmill_data.csv`: the crab (Carcinus maenas) treadmill responses of Santon M, Troscianko J, Heatubun CD, How MJ (2025),
"Stealth and deception: Adaptive motion camouflage in hunting broadclub cuttlefish", Science Advances 11(13): eadr3686,
doi 10.1126/sciadv.adr3686. From the authors' Dryad deposit doi 10.5061/dryad.jh9w0vtkq ("Supplementary_code_and_data.zip",
01_treadmill). Dryad publishes every deposit under the CC0 1.0 public-domain waiver (its stated policy); the waiver text was not re-read from this record's own page. Downloaded by Keith from Dryad on 2026-11-26 (Dryad refuses
automated downloads) and added unchanged: 754 lines (a header and 753 trials), 55 crabs, stimuli Grey / Static stripes /
Moving stripes at Weber contrasts 0.2 to 1.0; columns stimulus, stripe_wide_RGB, stripe_thin_RGB, contrast, crab_ID, sex,
response (0 = no, 1 = yes).

Upstream: the authors' Dryad deposit, https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.jh9w0vtkq (the DOI above as a link; a data release, not a repository).
EVIDENCE: the sha256 below is of the file as Keith downloaded it. NOT ESTABLISHED here: that it is still the deposit's current file, since Dryad refuses automated downloads and nothing in this tree has fetched it again.

Read for brain/STEALTH_ROUNDS_WIP.md ("The masking principle"): whether the low-contrast drop of static stripes is in the data.
